description: Look up a Private Enterprise Number (PEN). Pass exactly one of `pen` (a number such as 32473, or an OID under 1.3.6.1.4.1 such as 1.3.6.1.4.1.32473.1.2) or `organization` (words matched against organization names). Returns the organization and its OID prefix. Arcs below the enterprise number are assigned by the enterprise, not IANA. Contact details are not returned.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return, 1–100. Default 25.

offset.description: Number of organization matches to skip; pass the next_offset of the previous response to get the next page. Default 0.

organization.description: Words matched as whole tokens against the names of assigned entries, e.g. "cisco systems"; look up a number with pen to see a reserved or unassigned one. Pass this or pen, not both.

pen.description: Enterprise number, e.g. "32473", or an OID under 1.3.6.1.4.1 naming it, e.g. "1.3.6.1.4.1.32473.1.2" (a leading dot and the iso.org.dod.internet.private.enterprise prefix are accepted). Pass this or organization, not both.

name: iana_lookup_pen

enterprises.description: Matching entries: exact organization-name hits first, then number order.

organization.description: Organization line; absent when withheld or missing.

organization_withheld.description: True when the line mixes in contact details and is withheld.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `mode_required`: Neither or both of pen and organization were given. `upstream_unreadable`: The enterprise number file could not be fetched or parsed to zero records. `pacer_shed`: This server's own iana.org request queue is too full for the call to start in time. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

found.description: True when a returned number is assigned to an organization.

next_offset.description: Pass as offset for the next page; absent on the last.

notice.description: Guidance on a miss, a cut list, or another condition.

requested_oid.description: The OID as requested, when it named arcs below the enterprise number.

source.description: Provenance and freshness of the answer.

fetched_at.description: ISO 8601 time of the last successful fetch or revalidation.

registry_id.description: Id of the registry file that answered.

registry_updated.description: The registry's own last-updated date; absent for the protocol index.

stale.description: True when a refresh failed and a cached copy up to 7 days old answered.

sub_arcs.description: Arcs below the enterprise number, e.g. "1.2"; the enterprise assigns these.

totalCount.description: Matches before the limit was applied.

truncated.description: True when more matches exist than were returned.

title: Look up a Private Enterprise Number
